notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.

events.text:
Requirement completion review:

* **Two storeys** — *met*. Build has pieces at level 0 and level 1: piece:0,0,0;full + piece:0,0,1;full, piece:-1,0,0;full + piece:-1,0,1;full with snap connectors.
* **Bins on top** — *met*. Two bins on level 1: bin:-1,0,1~hex-bin-full and bin:0,0,1~hex-bin-full.
* **A drawer below** — *met*. drawer:0#0,1#cut on half base piece:0,1,0;half-s at level 0.
* **All edges capped** — *unmet*. check_build reports 23 faces still open (OPEN_CAP_FACE). Automatic capOpenFaces is refused with MESH_CLASH (hex-cap-edge-solid-m would run into hex-drawer-frame-n, 4.76mm > 0.50mm limit) at bearing 330 on -1,1,0. Manual capping of that face also fails. One edge cannot be capped without removing the drawer, so full edge capping is not achievable with this layout.

Build is verified with meshClash clear and joints locked.
